notes.title: Hopping Update!
notes.content:
As we received request from speedrunners, we enhanced our jumping. You can now run & jump like the wind!
How about some best time screens... ;)

notes.title: Local What?
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

Thank you for following our game and being so patient with us. :)
We are currently working on localization and some juicy details to have the best launch for Swaps and Traps.
So... We are doing our best to present you Swaps soon.[/b]
[h1]Ready to get lost in a single screen? ;)[/h1]
You can add to your wishlist today, to catch up with the latest news about Swaps and Traps.

[b]Best wishes from us all and we wish you the happiest new year![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30766576/d878bd1b6949a092cf5fff2093542fda8b56bed1.png[/img]
